sources.title: fanqi-robo/insert_gear_in_gripper · Datasets at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LeRobot v3 dataset with 50 bimanual YAM episodes at 20 FPS. Task: Insert a gear into the parallel gripper. Training episodes remaining after the low-quality and validation holdouts. Merged from insert_gear_in_gripper_1, _2, and _3. Episode metadata records source_repo_id and source_episode_index.

sources.title: Abhiram824/Isaac-GR00T-n17: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 - GitHub
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 is an open vision-language-action (VLA) model for generalized humanoid robot skills. This cross-embodiment model takes multimodal input, including language and images, to perform manipulation tasks in diverse environments.
